content.short: Social spin-and-win game that grew to 25 million players on Telegram and plays in World App.
content.description: Boinkers is a free-to-play social game where players spin for coins, climb leaderboards and take on journeys with friends. It became one of the most popular games on Telegram, with more than 25 million users and backing from a16z. Its Boinkers Coin Party version is available as a mini app in World App.
content.meta: Spin, collect coins and climb leaderboards in Boinkers, the a16z-backed social game with 25M+ players, now in World App.
content.pageTitle: Boinkers - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
